summary: October 26, 2026 briefing, compared with the October 20 baseline. Confirmed Walmart drawing today: Prismatic Evolutions 2-Pack Booster Bundle, 5–6 p.m. EDT. New-to-this-edition product listings and item limits are not evidence of policy changes this week. No substantive purchase-rule change in October 19–26 was established. Review chiefly covers Pokémon TCG; it is not an exhaustive calendar of all TCG releases. Other retailer opening times remain unverified.

retailers.coverage: Official Delta Reign product page read. November 6 is a street date, not an announced opening time. No new general quantity cap verified; marketplace listings and category pages were not treated as first-party drop confirmations.

confirmed.title: Delta Reign Booster Display: November 6 street date
confirmed.productName: Pokémon Trading Card Game: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign Booster Display
confirmed.dropAt: November 6, 2026 street date; Target opening time unannounced
confirmed.details: Page showed $179.99 and Out of Stock, with a November 6 street date and final-sale status. A listing does not confirm a restock, live preorder or fulfillment availability.
confirmed.planningImpact: Use the exact TCIN for the watchlist after verifying seller and product format; do not substitute a marketplace bundle or schedule checkout from the street date alone.
checks: Recheck seller, fulfillment, quantity cap and sale status on the exact page.
Wait for an official opening time; do not assume an overnight Friday drop.

retailers.coverage: Official drawing hub and FAQ read. Today's time window is verified; exact item ID and drawing-specific quantity cap were not exposed in the retrieved hub. Existing general limits rechecked against October 20; no dated rule change established.

confirmed.title: Today: Prismatic Evolutions drawing, 5–6 p.m. Eastern
confirmed.productName: Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Prismatic Evolutions 2Pk Booster Bundle
confirmed.details: Walmart lists an upcoming drawing entry window and a $79.94 price for this 2-pack. This is entry to a random drawing, not an immediate purchase or guaranteed order. The hub does not expose a verified item ID in the retrieved content.
confirmed.planningImpact: Treat this as a drawing-specific planning item, not a standard speed-checkout drop. Confirm the exact drawing item before entering any retailer SKU.
checks: Verify the drawing's product ID, permitted quantity and eligibility before entry.
Recheck the official window before 5 p.m. EDT; distinguish this bundle from a single booster bundle or an ETB bundle.

confirmed.title: Drawing entry locks checkout details and authorizes an order
confirmed.details: An account is required, entry is free, and each drawing permits one entry. Address, payment and quantity cannot be changed after entry; entries cannot be canceled. Selection triggers an automatic order, with charging conditional on successful processing. Existing-cart items cannot join that order. General Walmart caps may apply across person, household, account, payment and address.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm all entry details first. Follow the drawing's allowance rather than multiplying it by profile count. These rules are newly documented in this briefing, not proven newly introduced this week.
checks: Read drawing-specific eligibility and caps; no universal Walmart+ requirement was established here.
Check cancellation and return eligibility before entry.

Live stock, product caps and opening times remain unverified.

confirmed.details: The official indexed ETB listing identifies this Pokémon Center edition. The official press site confirms November 6 for the expansion; it does not announce a Pokémon Center restock or preorder opening. Full product-page stock and cap could not be checked.
confirmed.planningImpact: Keep the Pokémon Center edition separate from standard ETBs and Target's booster display. Do not treat indexed stock labels as live availability.
checks: Verify product-page quantity cap and preorder state before SKU selection.
Keep preorder and in-stock carts separate under the published queue guidance.

confirmed.title: Queue and cart guidance remains the baseline
confirmed.details: A queue alone does not establish a launch or guarantee stock. Keep the queue page open without refreshing; follow product-page limits and avoid mixing preorder with non-preorder items.
confirmed.planningImpact: Do not trigger a drop announcement from queue activity alone; recheck item eligibility and cart compatibility.
checks: Use the US site and read the current product-page limit.

retailers.coverage: Exact Paldea Partners product page and membership conditions read. This item-specific cap was not in the October 20 edition; its introduction date is unknown. No upcoming national warehouse or online drop time verified.

confirmed.title: Paldea Partners tins: item-specific daily membership cap
confirmed.details: The page specifies one transaction with at most two units per membership per day and labels this product Online Only. The numeric URL catalog ID differs from the displayed Costco item number. Current deliverable inventory was not verified.
confirmed.planningImpact: Use item 1901714 for identification and keep this online offer separate from warehouse stock. This cap is per membership, not per profile; do not generalize it to all Costco TCG items.
checks: Recheck deliverability and cap while signed in.

confirmed.title: Membership conditions rechecked
confirmed.details: Membership cards are non-transferable; warehouse entry and register checkout require the card.
confirmed.planningImpact: Check membership eligibility for each offer; an online listing does not establish local warehouse availability.
checks: Read the offer's membership and fulfillment conditions.

checks: Verify the club item number, stock, quantity limit and whether this specific offer requires Plus.
Do not transfer another product's historic two-unit limit to this item.

confirmed.title: Membership and Plus terms: baseline, not a verified new cap
confirmed.details: Membership cards are non-transferable. Plus benefits and eligible shipping have their own conditions; the terms' October 20 update date alone does not establish a new TCG limit.
confirmed.planningImpact: Verify membership eligibility and offer-specific access rather than assuming every card product is Plus-only.
checks: Check the exact product offer for access, shipping minimums and limits.
